meta.name: tps-review-local
meta.description: tps review (default) — reads the named agent workspace plus ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json as metadata. No LLM, no network, no writes: the workspace path is passed by the CLI as --read, and workdir is read-only. Linux note: Landlock cannot express deny-within-allow, so a deny nested inside an allowed parent makes nono refuse to start (it will not silently weaken the deny) — keep every deny at or above the allow roots. Matters for the exe.dev profiles (ops-mxf9). Never grant the state root: ~/.tps/secrets and ~/.tps/identity are siblings of the mailbox and agent state, so a grant or deny at ~/.tps level takes the mailbox and agent state with it.
